The site is Trailhead Youth Gear Locker — Equipment Repair & Maintenance Tickets, a support-helpdesk web application for Outdoor equipment loan repair and missing part tickets.

Owner brief: "Our outdoor club lends tents, camp stoves, and backpacks to youth groups, but our equipment damage ticketing app has critical bugs that lose repair reports on page refresh. Repair the application so damage reports are persisted on the server, the priority dropdown is accessible to screen readers, and invalid serial numbers display clear field validation."

Locale & copy conventions (en-US): Use $ prices, US English spelling and month-day dates. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-28/reference.jpg).

Art direction: Trailhead Youth Gear Locker — Equipment Repair & Maintenance Tickets: the page for outdoor equipment loan repair and missing part tickets, in a light palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #064e3b (th-forest), #eab308 (th-yellow), #1f2937 (th-slate), #ffffff (th-card), #d1d5db (th-border), #f9fafb (th-bg), #111827 (th-text), #6b7280 (th-muted). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 8px, content-frame 1200px, control-border 1px solid var(--th-border), page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.

Strictly avoid: a ticket reference shown once and never recoverable again; a second accent colour competing with the primary action; placeholder text standing in for a visible label; a modal or step wizard hiding part of the form; colour alone carrying an error with no message naming the field.

STEP 1 OF 4 (LIGHT MODE) — INITIAL OVERVIEW & READY WORKSPACE:

Render the initial landing state of Trailhead Youth Gear Locker — Equipment Repair & Maintenance Tickets as a visitor first meets it on the primary workspace. Top-to-bottom structure: a brand header, then a navigation bar, then a main content area, then a content section, then the working form, then a footer.

Show the active overview/dashboard/ledger/catalogue surface populated with realistic, internally consistent records and totals, alongside the ready-to-use interactive form with visible labels for every control ("Reported by", "Gear serial number", "Equipment type", "Fault description", "Urgency").

User journey context: Check equipment inventory and identify a tent or backpack needing zipper or pole repair. Fill out the damage ticket form with gear serial number, issue description, and urgency. Submit the ticket, review the confirmation reference number, and reload the ticket page to verify.

Include editorial photography where appropriate to the subject, a concise social-proof or status summary row, and the complete site footer.
